preconditions.description: The number of integers n must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each integer a_i must be between 0 and 9.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= len(s) <= 3 and all(c in '+-*' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must contain between 1 and 3 distinct symbols from '+', '-', and '*'.

postconditions.description: The output must be a valid expression formed by the numbers and symbols.
The number of symbols used in the expression must be exactly n - 1.

postconditions.expression: all(c in s for c in symbols)
postconditions.description: All symbols used in the expression must be from the allowed symbols in s.
